about: How to cut textures/blocks/sheets/<name>.png (3 x 3 cells laid out like the block face, cell = width / 3) into pictures. Shared by build-textures.ps1 (web) and Atlas.Build (desktop). cells: picture suffix -> [column, row]; 'full' means no suffix (the plain picture <name>). compose: pictures put together from quarters (TL, TR, BL, BR) of the cell pictures; a quarter not listed stays see-through. A fully see-through cell is a picture that isn't there. A loose file with the same name wins.
